Use case: style-transfer. Asset: a single transparent low-resolution medieval RPG dialogue portrait, portrait-aspect canvas approximating 74:100. Make a substantial fresh drawing of the identity in reference 1, using references 2-5 ONLY for pixel language and close framing (Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore). Those references are not other characters to combine. Design for exactly 74 x 100 logical pixels with clear stepped one-pixel edges, broad connected clusters, 24-32 muted colors, no antialiasing, no dithering, no soft painted rendering, no texture noise. Face occupies most of the image: a complete large head, very short visible neck, only a tiny narrow collar at the bottom. Full hair/headwear and ears entirely inside the canvas; transparent clearance at least 2-3 logical pixels above and on both sides, including any scarf tail. Nose and cheekbones use decisive asymmetric broad angular light/shadow planes. Small dark eyes under heavy eyelids; eye whites at most one muted gray-beige logical pixel, no bright white sclera or catchlights. No generic anime face or glossy skin, no beauty portrait, no big eyes, no decorative border, no text, no tools, no hands, no body or shoulders, no extra objects. Genuine transparent RGBA background.
Identity lock: Saifu (赛芙), MNS-S01-NPC, a female relocated trial grower in her THIRTIES. The latest character card overrides the warmer source lighting: use relatively PALE skin, muted beige highlights and rosy-brown shadows, not orange tan. Preserve short dark brown almost-black bobbed hair, the simple plain muted rust-red kerchief tied at the rear with a small complete tail, the navy-blue old work dress, tiny brown apron straps, modest cream neck edge. Make her clearly about 36: mature cheekbone planes, subtly heavy lower lids and one restrained nasolabial shadow, natural firm rounded jaw, robust large nasal bridge and tip. Do not make a teenager, doe-eyed girl, elderly woman, or exotic outsider stereotype. Slight three-quarter head toward viewer-left like the source. Her individuality: observant level squint, cautious dignity, one eyebrow slightly raised, lips firmly closed with a quiet questioning set, no helpless sadness or harsh villain anger. Chunky nose/cheek and restrained eyes should do more expression work than many fine wrinkles. Keep the entire headscarf crown, knot and both small tails, hair edges and visible ear intact with true transparent padding. Very short neck and only a narrow navy/cream/brown collar sliver at bottom. No plants, seeds, grapes, tools, harvest or ownership event.
